title: Metamorphic proteins under a computational microscope: Lessons from a fold-switching RfaH protein.
one_liner_zh: 该文以计算显微镜视角综述RfaH蛋白的折叠转换机制，虽涉及转录因子但聚焦蛋白质构象动态而非TF-DNA结合互作，方法上涵盖计算模拟但非AI/物理模拟核心，故为中档匹配。
abstract: Metamorphic proteins constitute unexpected paradigms of the protein folding problem, as their sequences encode two alternative folds, which reversibly interconvert within biologically relevant timescales to trigger different cellular responses. Once considered a rare aberration, metamorphism may be common among proteins that must respond to rapidly changing environments, exemplified by NusG-like proteins, the only transcription factors present in every domain of life. RfaH, a specialized paralog of bacterial NusG, undergoes an all-alpha to all-beta domain switch to activate expression of virulence and conjugation genes in many animal and plant pathogens and is the quintessential example of a metamorphic protein. The dramatic nature of RfaH structural transformation and the richness of its evolutionary history makes for an excellent model for studying how metamorphic proteins switch folds. Here, we summarize the structural and functional evidence that sparked the discovery of RfaH as a metamorphic protein, the experimental and computational approaches that enabled the description of the molecular mechanism and refolding pathways of its structural interconversion, and the ongoing efforts to find signatures and general properties to ultimately describe the protein metamorphome.
abstract_zh: 变构蛋白构成了蛋白质折叠问题中意想不到的范式，因为其序列编码两种可交替的折叠构象，这些构象在生物学相关时间尺度内可逆地相互转换，以触发不同的细胞反应。曾被视为罕见异常现象的变构行为，在必须响应快速变化环境的蛋白质中可能普遍存在，NusG样蛋白即为典型例证，这类蛋白是唯一存在于所有生命域中的转录因子。RfaH是细菌NusG的一个特化旁系同源物，通过全α到全β结构域转换来激活多种动植物病原体中毒力基因和接合基因的表达，是变构蛋白的典型代表。RfaH结构转变的剧烈程度及其进化历史的丰富性，使其成为研究变构蛋白如何切换折叠构象的极佳模型。在此，我们总结了引发RfaH作为变构蛋白发现的的结构与功能证据，描述了其结构互转换的分子机制和重折叠途径所采用的实验与计算方法，以及当前为寻找特征和普遍性质以最终描绘蛋白质变构组所做的持续努力。
